findings.title: Migration c8d2f6a1b9e3 has no unit test
findings.problem: The new migration drops and recreates ck_model_whitelist_requires_default with the relaxed predicate, but no test in tests/codemie/migrations covers it, although neighbouring migrations each have one that mocks op, asserts DDL arguments and checks the revision chain. Every service test mocks the repository and session, so none exercises the constraint.
findings.impact: A wrong constraint name, table, schema or predicate (or a revert to the strict form) would not fail any test; create_shared_project_in_session and update_allowed_models(None, default) would then violate the CHECK at commit time in a real database. The source was read and is currently correct, so this is a regression gap rather than a live bug.
findings.recommendation: Add tests/codemie/migrations/test_c8d2f6a1b9e3_relax_model_whitelist_default_check.py in the style of test_add_cli_analytics_enabled_to_applications.py: monkeypatch module.op, call upgrade(), assert op.drop_constraint('ck_model_whitelist_requires_default', 'applications', schema='codemie', type_='check') and op.create_check_constraint with the same name, 'applications', 'allowed_models IS NULL OR default_model IS NOT NULL', schema='codemie'; assert down_revision == 'aad1456a4f17' and that downgrade() makes no op calls.
